description: Gap diagnosis for claim C3 (user approved 2026-11-08): the synthetic RRWP GatedGCN with the PR's cosine learning-rate decay, same 4 seeds, dataset, split and model as candidate synthetic_rrwp of sweep synthetic (constant lr). Compared against that candidate's runs.
split: test (10% of the 800 generated graphs, split seed 1729)
checkpoint_rule: model with the highest validation accuracy over the 200 epochs, evaluated once on the test split
aggregation: per-seed values, mean and sample standard deviation over the four seeds
tie_rule: descriptive diagnostic: report per seed whether the run leaves chance (test accuracy above 0.6) and the first epoch with validation accuracy >= 0.95, next to the constant-lr runs of the same seed
